description: A Java class named VoiceRecognition that demonstrates how to invoke Android's speech recognition API within an activity. It includes UI handling for starting recognition, checking for recognition activity presence, and processing recognition results, along with managing supported languages.

classes.name: VoiceRecognition
classes.description: An Activity class that demonstrates speech recognition invocation, managing supported languages, and displaying recognition results.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI components, verifies recognition activity presence, and refreshes voice settings.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks to start voice recognition.

methods.name: startVoiceRecognitionActivity
methods.description: Creates an intent to start speech recognition with specified parameters and launches it.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Processes the recognition activity result and updates the list view with recognized speech strings.

methods.name: refreshVoiceSettings
methods.description: Broadcasts an intent to get supported language details for voice recognition.

methods.name: updateSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Updates the UI spinner with the list of supported languages.

methods.name: updateLanguagePreference
methods.description: Displays the preferred language in a text view.
